attr.title: KeeperFX
attr.desc: Open-source engine recreation and expansion for Dungeon Keeper.
attr.desc_md: [KeeperFX](https://keeperfx.net) is an open-source engine recreation and expansion for Dungeon Keeper.
attr.inst: Install KeeperFX with legally owned Dungeon Keeper data on a PC, then copy its data folders into ports/keeperfx. See the README for the exact folders.
attr.inst_md: Install [KeeperFX](https://keeperfx.net) with legally owned Dungeon Keeper data on a PC, then copy its data folders into `ports/keeperfx`. See the README for the exact folders.
